import json, time, urllib.request, datetime
out=[]; lt=None; stop=int(datetime.datetime(2026,8,25,tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp())
for i in range(30):
    url='https://api.opendota.com/api/proMatches' + (f'?less_than_match_id={lt}' if lt else '')
    with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'curl/8.7.1'}), timeout=40) as r: page=json.load(r)
    if not page: break
    out+=page; lt=min(m['match_id'] for m in page)
    if min(m['start_time'] for m in page) < stop: break
    time.sleep(1.1)
json.dump(out, open(__file__.replace('.py','.json'),'w'))
print('pages', i+1, 'matches', len(out))
opendota.extraction: Each contiguous 100-record slice is one original response page; 800 records = 8 pages.
